thread:
anya: heads-up: PMs pushed for a 'mini-pilot' we can ship in 2 sprints to two mobile customers. need a trimmed scope decision today.
sam: what are the non-negotiables from customers?
rachel: short list: reduce token cost by >=20%, keep perceived latency ~same, and no regressions on payments/auth flows. they prefer quick wins over polishing.
matt: technical constraints: one customer uses 1.5k token avg, other 600. both see bursty traffic. 4-bit helps cost but increases flakiness on some long-answer prompts.
lucy: ops note: last batch rollout caused 30% SE tickets for truncated outputs. we need eval hooks and rollback guardrails.
anya: proposal A (narrow): adaptive micro-batching + server-side prefix caching hints + eval-trigger alerting. skip client caching and aggressive quant for pilot. Proposal B (bolder): same + 4-bit quant for short contexts with automatic 16-bit fallback. B risks higher regressions.
sam: timeline check: if we pick A, eng runtime can deliver feature-flagged rollout + basic alerting in 2 sprints. B adds 2-3 days of eval work + more rollout safety.
matt: for alerting, recommend both automated metrics + lightweight human review. suggested signals: 1) eval-concordance on golden sets, 2) sudden drop in ngram overlap, 3) increase in post-edit rate from SE portal.
rachel: we can provide golden prompt sets (payment_ui, onboarding, search) and proxy labels for concordance. i'll own collection.
lucy: runbook must include quick rollback steps, contact list (support, eng-runtime, customer-success), and a short customer-facing blurb. i'll draft.
sam: acceptance criteria for pilot success: - cost/unit reduction >=20% on pilot traffic - p50 latency <= baseline+5% and p95 <= baseline+20% - concordance >= 0.97 vs golden set - <=2 SE escalations/week.
anya: good. decision: ship A for pilot, keep B as opt-in experiment behind separate flag for experiment cohort. aim: shipping A by end of sprint, B for internal experiment in the following week.
matt: quick config snippet for eval-alert rule we'll use (feels: lightweight):
```
- name: mobile-mini-pilot-alert
  eval_sets: [payment_ui, onboarding, short_answers]
  metrics:
    concordance: 0.97
    p95_latency_factor: 1.2
  actions:
    - webhook: #optimize-ops
    - rollback: true
    - annotated-check: true  # open ticket for triage if triggered
```
rachel: nice. i'll align customer traffic windows and schedule the pilot with both customers in next sprint.
sam: i'll own the feature flag rollout steps and the telemetry dashboards (cost per token, per-route concordance, latency distributions).
lucy: support templates incoming. also adding a short FAQ for customers about why we might fallback to higher precision.
devops-bot: feature-flag scaffolding merged to staging at 1745120200. deployment pipeline green.
anya: thanks. next sync Thurs to confirm runbook PRs and final golden sets. :tada:
